day_shape: 84 items: US fighter jets struck IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island after Iranian drones targeted Bahrain, CNN reports Iran 'dirty bomb' plot against Trump officials with Rubio denying imminent threat, CENTCOM chief Cooper in Israel, Asif Merchant sentenced 27.5 years, Iran claims MQ-9 downed over Hormuz; no UK Parliament items.

threads.label: US-Iran strikes around Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: A US military official said US fighter jets used precision munitions to strike an IRGC missile-launch site on Qeshm Island, following Iranian drone activity that triggered a Bahrain all-clear warning. Defa Press claimed Iran's army air defence destroyed an American MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz, and CENTCOM posted footage of USS Theodore Roosevelt and USS George Washington sailing together in the Arabian Sea.

threads.label: Alleged Iran dirty-bomb and assassination plots
threads.summary: CNN reported US intelligence suggesting Iran is working on plans to target senior Trump administration figures with a dirty bomb or chemical weapon in Washington, with Secretary of State Rubio saying he did not believe there was an imminent threat. A US federal court sentenced Pakistani national Asif Merchant to 27.5 years for an IRGC-linked plot to kill Trump and other officials.

threads.label: IRGC/Hezbollah plot on Israeli embassy Bangkok
threads.summary: Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah, acting under IRGC Quds Force direction, recruited six Thai clerics who had studied in Qom for a plot to attack the Israeli embassy in Bangkok, which intelligence sources said failed. The reports cited a Western intelligence source and a source close to the Quds Force.

threads.label: CENTCOM-IDF coordination and Gaza operations
threads.summary: CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper arrived in Israel for a working meeting with IDF Chief of Staff Lt.-Gen. Eyal Zamir focused on the Iranian threat, while Defence Minister Katz said Israel will hold security zones in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria indefinitely. The IDF launched an operation beyond the Yellow Line in central Gaza's Bureij and Nuseirat, published footage of a dismantled Hezbollah tunnel at Mount Dov, and Hamas called the Gaza operation a ceasefire violation.

threads.label: Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani death and commemoration
threads.summary: Khamenei's office issued a condolence message calling Grand Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani one of the principal pillars of teaching jurisprudence in the seminary, with commemorative sessions on his behalf announced in Mashhad and Qom for Thursday 28 Aban. Defa Press reported the ayatollah's body was laid to rest in Qom.

threads.label: Iran domestic unrest and Abdanan protests
threads.summary: Iran International reported protests over the deaths of 13 oil and gas workers in a bus crash escalated into anti-establishment demonstrations in western Iran, with security forces firing tear gas and arresting protesters. Further pieces covered solidarity messages for Abdanan, the killing of a 16-year-old schoolgirl in Kermanshah prompting calls for legal reform, and criticism of wartime loyalist rallies targeting officials.

threads.label: Iran defence posture and IAEA friction
threads.summary: Khamenei issued an order to senior armed forces commanders calling for an immediate, effective and geographically unlimited response to any potential enemy threat, while IRIB said IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi stated the agency cannot verify Iran's declared nuclear materials and facilities except for Bushehr. Defa Press carried commentary urging revision of Iran's defence doctrine and claims the armed forces' 'finger is on the trigger.'
